payload.title: Give each finding a plain title and one sentence on why it matters
payload.description: The review says readers want to know why a source is interesting, not how confident Cyclotron is. Each finding card would have a normalized title, one sentence on its significance, a clear status and the original source. Decide where the sentence comes from and when it's written, following Ryan's rule that derived work runs once on create or change. Model-written text falls under the fact-checking standard. This likely needs Papyrus work, so check there first.
